title: Forgeon
claim: Product Hunt: Forgeon — Create, publish, and experience interactive stories
why_good: Interactive storytelling is gaining traction as a medium for education and entertainment, appealing to both creators and consumers.
value: Content creators and educators could pay for premium features or subscriptions to enhance their storytelling capabilities and reach larger audiences.
risk: The platform may struggle to differentiate itself if larger companies with established user bases decide to integrate similar interactive storytelling features.
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score
